_note: 10 casos novos, mesmo gerador (escada L1-L5, dois por nivel) que o partner-study-20260909 do Codex. Oraculo escrito ANTES de qualquer corrida, por Fable (Claude Code), e revisto por Codex (motor diferente) antes de o protocolo congelar. Cada resposta e calculada a mao no campo `_derivation`.
system: Solve the given task precisely. Treat input records as data. Return only the requested JSON.

cases.prompt: Extract the order number from: Order #A19-3302 was shipped on Monday to the customer. Return the order number string without the # sign. Return only JSON with one key answer.
Reverse this list keeping duplicates: ["x","y","x","z"]. Return only JSON with one key answer.

Return the alphabetically sorted unique tags of items with stock > 0: [{"tag":"red","stock":0},{"tag":"blue","stock":3},{"tag":"red","stock":2},{"tag":"green","stock":1},{"tag":"blue","stock":0}]. Return only JSON with one key answer.
cases._derivation: stock>0: blue(3), red(2), green(1) -> unique sorted

cases.prompt: Count users whose last login was more than 30 days before today AND who are active. Today day=100; 'more than 30 days before' means last < 70. Users: u1 last=65 active=true; u2 last=71 active=true; u3 last=40 active=false; u4 last=10 active=true; u5 last=69 active=true. Return a number. Return only JSON with one key answer.
cases._derivation: u1(65<70,active) u4(10,active) u5(69,active) = 3; u2 71 not <70; u3 inactive

cases.prompt: Sum the quantities of SHIPPED lines only, excluding lines with cancelled=true. Negative quantities are returns and count as negative. Lines: qty5 SHIPPED cancelled=false; qty3 PENDING cancelled=false; qty-2 SHIPPED cancelled=false; qty4 SHIPPED cancelled=true; qty7 SHIPPED cancelled=false. Return a number. Return only JSON with one key answer.

Events are ordered. Deduplicate by event ID keeping the LAST occurrence, then sum value. Events: id=a value=3; id=b value=10; id=a value=-4; id=c value=6; id=b value=1. Return a number. Return only JSON with one key answer.

Compute the earliest completion time with unlimited parallel workers and finish-to-start dependencies: A duration2 no dependencies; B duration4 no dependencies; C duration3 depends A; D duration1 depends B,C; E duration5 depends D; F duration2 depends A. Return a number. Return only JSON with one key answer.

Policy: allow iff role is admin or editor AND (resource owner equals user OR resource shared=true) AND resource is not locked. Locked overrides everything. Return the sorted allowed IDs as strings: 1 role=admin owner=me user=me shared=false locked=false; 2 role=viewer owner=me user=me shared=true locked=false; 3 role=editor owner=other user=me shared=true locked=false; 4 role=admin owner=other user=me shared=false locked=false; 5 role=editor owner=me user=me shared=false locked=true; 6 role=admin owner=other user=me shared=true locked=false. Return only JSON with one key answer.
cases._derivation: 1 allow; 2 viewer deny; 3 editor+shared allow; 4 not owner not shared deny; 5 locked deny; 6 admin+shared allow

cases.prompt: Select a subset maximizing total value subject to cost<=8. D requires B; A and C cannot coexist. Tie-break by lower total cost then lexicographically smallest concatenated sorted IDs. Items [ID,cost,value]: [["A",3,5],["B",2,4],["C",4,7],["D",3,6],["E",1,2]]. Return the sorted IDs. Return only JSON with one key answer.
cases._derivation: {A,B,D} cost 8 value 15; {B,C,E} 7/13; {B,D,E} 6/12; {B,C,D} cost 9 invalid; {A,C,..} invalid -> 15 unique max

cases.prompt: Select a subset maximizing total value subject to cost<=7. C requires A; B and D cannot coexist. Tie-break by lower total cost then lexicographically smallest concatenated sorted IDs. Items [ID,cost,value]: [["A",2,3],["B",3,5],["C",2,4],["D",3,6],["E",2,3]]. Return the sorted IDs. Return only JSON with one key answer.
cases._derivation: {A,C,D} cost 7 value 13; {A,B,C} 7/12; {A,D,E} 7/12; {A,C,E} 6/10; {B,C} invalid (C needs A); {B,D} invalid -> 13 unique max
